description: A sprite sheet of SIXTEEN tiny separate ground details arranged in a 4 by 4 grid, each very small and centered in its own cell, seen from slightly above lying flat on the ground: dry yellow dead grass tufts, small scattered bones, tiny skulls, cracked dark grey pebbles, dead brown leaves, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every detail fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background, no ground fill, no text

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky pixel art, thick dark outline, soft cel shading.
